notifications.title: Set one end screen on each long video
notifications.detail: Guides rate a single, specific next video as the best ending for session watch time. End screens can only be set in YouTube Studio, at upload.
notifications.fix: 1. When uploading a long video, open Editor → End screen. 2. Add one 'Video' element pointing to our closest long video in subject. 3. Add the Subscribe element. Nothing else.

notifications.title: Long-video settings still say 1 a week and up to 900 s
notifications.detail: config/settings.json (synced from the dashboard) has longPerWeek 1 and longLengthMaxSec 900. Your rules are two long videos a week, Wed and Fri (16 Nov), at 180-240 s (12 Nov). Because of this, Studio targets one a week, and a 380 s video (L-20261111-01) passed the length check.
notifications.fix: 1. Open the dashboard Settings page. 2. Set longPerWeek to 2 and longLengthMaxSec to 240 (longLengthMinSec stays 180). 3. Check that longUploadDays is Wednesday and Friday. 4. The next ingest writes them to config/settings.json.
